            title="Optional">
        <span id="cam_role_name_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#cam_role_name_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cam_<wbr>role_<wbr>name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>CAM role name authorized to access.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="cdh_host_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#cdh_host_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cdh_<wbr>host_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Id of cdh instance. Note: it only works when instanceChargeType is set to <code>CDHPAID</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="cdh_instance_type_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#cdh_instance_type_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cdh_<wbr>instance_<wbr>type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Type of instance created on cdh, the value of this parameter is in the format of CDH_XCXG based on the number of CPU cores and memory capacity. Note: it only works when instanceChargeType is set to <code>CDHPAID</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="cpu_topology_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#cpu_topology_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cpu_<wbr>topology</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#instancecputopology">object</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>CPU topology configuration. Only supported when creating instances.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="data_disks_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#data_disks_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">data_<wbr>disks</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#instancedatadisk">list(object)</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Settings for data disks.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="dedicated_cluster_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#dedicated_cluster_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">dedicated_<wbr>cluster_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Exclusive cluster id.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="dedicated_resource_pack_ids_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#dedicated_resource_pack_ids_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">dedicated_<wbr>resource_<wbr>pack_<wbr>ids</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">list(string)</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>List of dedicated resource pack IDs (e.g., rpp-xxxxxxxx). When creating instances using pre-purchased resource pool packs, this parameter must be specified together with <code>dedicatedResourcePackTenancy</code> to match the corresponding tenancy strategy. Related resource: <code>tencentcloudCvmResourcePoolPacks</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="dedicated_resource_pack_tenancy_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#dedicated_resource_pack_tenancy_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">dedicated_<wbr>resource_<wbr>pack_<wbr>tenancy</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Dedicated resource pack tenancy strategy. Valid values: <code>ResourcePool</code> (use instance resource pool for resource pre-deduction).</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="disable_api_termination_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#disable_api_termination_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable_<wbr>api_<wbr>termination</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether the termination protection is enabled. Default is <code>false</code>. If set true, which means that this instance can not be deleted by an API action.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="disable_automation_service_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#disable_automation_service_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable_<wbr>automation_<wbr>service</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Disable enhance service for automation, it is enabled by default. When this options is set, monitor agent won't be installed. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="disable_monitor_service_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#disable_monitor_service_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable_<wbr>monitor_<wbr>service</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Disable enhance service for monitor, it is enabled by default. When this options is set, monitor agent won't be installed. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="disable_security_service_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#disable_security_service_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable_<wbr>security_<wbr>service</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Disable enhance service for security, it is enabled by default. When this options is set, security agent won't be installed. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="disaster_recover_group_ids_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#disaster_recover_group_ids_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disaster_<wbr>recover_<wbr>group_<wbr>ids</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">list(string)</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Placement group ID list. Supports up to 3 group IDs. When set, <code>placementGroupId</code> will be ignored and this list will be used for CRUD operations.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="enable_jumbo_frame_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#enable_jumbo_frame_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">enable_<wbr>jumbo_<wbr>frame</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to enable jumbo frames for the instance. Only supported instance types accept <code>true</code>. See https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/213/11518 for supported instance types. <strong>NOTE: modifying this field automatically reboots the instance (<code>AutoReboot</code> is always set to <code>true</code> on update); use with caution</strong>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="force_delete_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#force_delete_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">force_<wbr>delete</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicate whether to force delete the instance. Default is <code>false</code>. If set true, the instance will be permanently deleted instead of being moved into the recycle bin. Note: only works for <code>PREPAID</code> instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="force_replace_placement_group_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#force_replace_placement_group_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">force_<wbr>replace_<wbr>placement_<wbr>group_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to force the instance host to be replaced. Value range: true: Allows the instance to change the host and restart the instance. Local disk machines do not support specifying this parameter; false: Does not allow the instance to change the host and only join the placement group on the current host. This may cause the placement group to fail to change. Can be used with both <code>placementGroupId</code> and <code>disasterRecoverGroupIds</code>. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="force_stop_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#force_stop_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">force_<wbr>stop</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to forcibly shut down a running instance. Default is false. Forcing a shutdown is equivalent to switching off the power button on a physical computer. Forcing a shutdown may result in data loss or file system corruption; therefore, please use this option only when the server cannot be shut down normally.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="hostname_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#hostname_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">hostname</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The hostname of the instance. Windows instance: The name should be a combination of 2 to 15 characters comprised of letters (case insensitive), numbers, and hyphens (-). Period (.) is not supported, and the name cannot be a string of pure numbers. Other types (such as Linux) of instances: The name should be a combination of 2 to 60 characters, supporting multiple periods (.). The piece between two periods is composed of letters (case insensitive), numbers, and hyphens (-). Changing the <code>hostname</code> will cause the instance system to restart.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="hpc_cluster_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#hpc_cluster_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">hpc_<wbr>cluster_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>High-performance computing cluster ID. If the instance created is a high-performance computing instance, you need to specify the cluster in which the instance is placed, otherwise it cannot be specified.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="image_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#image_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">image_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The image to use for the instance. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="instance_charge_type_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#instance_charge_type_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance_<wbr>charge_<wbr>type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The charge type of instance. Valid values are <code>PREPAID</code>, <code>POSTPAID_BY_HOUR</code>, <code>SPOTPAID</code>, <code>CDHPAID</code> and <code>CDCPAID</code>. The default is <code>POSTPAID_BY_HOUR</code>. Note: TencentCloud International only supports <code>POSTPAID_BY_HOUR</code> and <code>CDHPAID</code>. <code>PREPAID</code> instance may not allow to delete before expired. <code>SPOTPAID</code> instance must set <code>spotInstanceType</code> and <code>spotMaxPrice</code> at the same time. <code>CDHPAID</code> instance must set <code>cdhInstanceType</code> and <code>cdhHostId</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="instance_charge_type_prepaid_period_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#instance_charge_type_prepaid_period_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance_<wbr>charge_<wbr>type_<wbr>prepaid_<wbr>period</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The tenancy (time unit is month) of the prepaid instance, NOTE: it only works when instanceChargeType is set to <code>PREPAID</code>. Valid values are <code>1</code>, <code>2</code>, <code>3</code>, <code>4</code>, <code>5</code>, <code>6</code>, <code>7</code>, <code>8</code>, <code>9</code>, <code>10</code>, <code>11</code>, <code>12</code>, <code>24</code>, <code>36</code>, <code>48</code>, <code>60</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="instance_charge_type_prepaid_renew_flag_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#instance_charge_type_prepaid_renew_flag_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance_<wbr>charge_<wbr>type_<wbr>prepaid_<wbr>renew_<wbr>flag</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Auto renewal flag. Valid values: <code>NOTIFY_AND_AUTO_RENEW</code>: notify upon expiration and renew automatically, <code>NOTIFY_AND_MANUAL_RENEW</code>: notify upon expiration but do not renew automatically, <code>DISABLE_NOTIFY_AND_MANUAL_RENEW</code>: neither notify upon expiration nor renew automatically. Default value: <code>NOTIFY_AND_MANUAL_RENEW</code>. If this parameter is specified as <code>NOTIFY_AND_AUTO_RENEW</code>, the instance will be automatically renewed on a monthly basis if the account balance is sufficient. NOTE: it only works when instanceChargeType is set to <code>PREPAID</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="instance_name_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#instance_name_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance_<wbr>name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The name of the instance. The max length of instanceName is 128, and default value is <code>Terraform-CVM-Instance</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="instance_type_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#instance_type_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance_<wbr>type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The type of the instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="internet_charge_type_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#internet_charge_type_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">internet_<wbr>charge_<wbr>type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Internet charge type of the instance, Valid values are <code>BANDWIDTH_PREPAID</code>, <code>TRAFFIC_POSTPAID_BY_HOUR</code>, <code>BANDWIDTH_POSTPAID_BY_HOUR</code> and <code>BANDWIDTH_PACKAGE</code>. If not set, internet charge type are consistent with the cvm charge type by default. This value takes NO Effect when changing and does not need to be set when <code>allocatePublicIp</code> is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="internet_max_bandwidth_out_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#internet_max_bandwidth_out_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">internet_<wbr>max_<wbr>bandwidth_<wbr>out</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Maximum outgoing bandwidth to the public network, measured in Mbps (Mega bits per second). This value does not need to be set when <code>allocatePublicIp</code> is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="ipv4_address_type_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#ipv4_address_type_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ipv4_<wbr>address_<wbr>type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>AddressType. Default value: WanIP. For beta users of dedicated IP. the value can be: HighQualityEIP: Dedicated IP. Note that dedicated IPs are only available in partial regions. For beta users of Anti-DDoS IP, the value can be: AntiDDoSEIP: Anti-DDoS EIP. Note that Anti-DDoS IPs are only available in partial regions.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="ipv6_address_count_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#ipv6_address_count_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ipv6_<wbr>address_<wbr>count</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify the number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses for the Elastic Network Interface.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="ipv6_address_type_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#ipv6_address_type_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ipv6_<wbr>address_<wbr>type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>IPv6 AddressType. Default value: WanIP. EIPv6: Elastic IPv6; HighQualityEIPv6: Premium IPv6, only China Hong Kong supports premium IPv6. To allocate IPv6 addresses to resources, please specify the Elastic IPv6 type.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="keep_image_login_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#keep_image_login_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">keep_<wbr>image_<wbr>login</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to keep image login or not, default is <code>false</code>. When the image type is private or shared or imported, this parameter can be set <code>true</code>. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system..</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="key_ids_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#key_ids_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">key_<wbr>ids</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">list(string)</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The key pair to use for the instance, it looks like <code>skey-16jig7tx</code>. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-deprecated"
            title="Optional, Deprecated">
        <span id="key_name_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#key_name_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">key_<wbr>name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Please use <code>keyIds</code> instead. The key pair to use for the instance, it looks like <code>skey-16jig7tx</code>. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.<p class="property-message">Deprecated: Please use <code>keyIds</code> instead.</p></dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="launch_template_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#launch_template_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">launch_<wbr>template_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Instance launch template ID. This parameter allows you to create an instance using the preset parameters in the instance template.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="launch_template_version_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#launch_template_version_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">launch_<wbr>template_<wbr>version</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The instance launch template version number. If given, a new instance launch template will be created based on the given version number.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="orderly_security_groups_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#orderly_security_groups_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">orderly_<wbr>security_<wbr>groups</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">list(string)</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>A list of orderly security group IDs to associate with.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="partition_number_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#partition_number_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">partition_<wbr>number</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The partition number of the placement group. Valid values: 1-30. If not specified when creating an instance with a partition placement group, the partition number will be randomly assigned. Required when modifying <code>disasterRecoverGroupIds</code> or <code>placementGroupId</code> in update operations.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-secret"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="password_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#password_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">password</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Password for the instance. In order for the new password to take effect, the instance will be restarted after the password change. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="placement_group_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#placement_group_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">placement_<wbr>group_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The ID of a placement group.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="private_ip_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#private_ip_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">private_<wbr>ip</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The private IP to be assigned to this instance, must be in the provided subnet and available.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="project_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#project_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">project_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The project the instance belongs to, default to 0.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="release_address_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#release_address_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">release_<wbr>address</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Release elastic IP. Under EIP 2.0, only the first EIP under the primary network card is provided, and the EIP types are limited to HighQualityEIP, AntiDDoSEIP, EIPv6, and HighQualityEIPv6. Default behavior is not released.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="running_flag_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#running_flag_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">running_<wbr>flag</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Set instance to running or stop. Default value is true, the instance will shutdown when this flag is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-deprecated"
            title="Optional, Deprecated">
        <span id="security_groups_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#security_groups_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">security_<wbr>groups</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">list(string)</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>It will be deprecated. Use <code>orderlySecurityGroups</code> instead. A list of security group IDs to associate with.<p class="property-message">Deprecated: It will be deprecated. Use <code>orderlySecurityGroups</code> instead.</p></dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="spot_instance_type_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#spot_instance_type_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">spot_<wbr>instance_<wbr>type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Type of spot instance, only support <code>ONE-TIME</code> now. Note: it only works when instanceChargeType is set to <code>SPOTPAID</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="spot_max_price_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#spot_max_price_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">spot_<wbr>max_<wbr>price</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Max price of a spot instance, is the format of decimal string, for example &quot;0.50&quot;. Note: it only works when instanceChargeType is set to <code>SPOTPAID</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="stop_type_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#stop_type_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">stop_<wbr>type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Instance shutdown mode. Valid values: SOFT_FIRST: perform a soft shutdown first, and force shut down the instance if the soft shutdown fails; HARD: force shut down the instance directly; SOFT: soft shutdown only. Default value: SOFT.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="stopped_mode_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#stopped_mode_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">stopped_<wbr>mode</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Billing method of a pay-as-you-go instance after shutdown. Available values: <code>KEEP_CHARGING</code>,<code>STOP_CHARGING</code>. Default <code>KEEP_CHARGING</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="subnet_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#subnet_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">subnet_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The ID of a VPC subnet. If you want to create instances in a VPC network, this parameter must be set.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="system_disk_encrypt_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#system_disk_encrypt_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">system_<wbr>disk_<wbr>encrypt</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether the system disk is encrypted. Valid values: true (encrypted), false (not encrypted). Default value: false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="system_disk_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#system_disk_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">system_<wbr>disk_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>System disk snapshot ID used to initialize the system disk. When system disk type is <code>LOCAL_BASIC</code> and <code>LOCAL_SSD</code>, disk id is not supported.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="system_disk_kms_key_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#system_disk_kms_key_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">system_<wbr>disk_<wbr>kms_<wbr>key_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Custom KMS key ID for system disk encryption.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="system_disk_name_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#system_disk_name_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">system_<wbr>disk_<wbr>name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Name of the system disk.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="system_disk_resize_online_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#system_disk_resize_online_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">system_<wbr>disk_<wbr>resize_<wbr>online</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Resize online.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="system_disk_size_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#system_disk_size_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">system_<wbr>disk_<wbr>size</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">number</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Size of the system disk. unit is GB, Default is 50GB. If modified, the instance may force stop.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="system_disk_type_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#system_disk_type_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">system_<wbr>disk_<wbr>type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>System disk type. For more information on limits of system disk types, see <a href="https://intl.cloud.tencent.com/document/product/213/4952">Storage Overview</a>. Valid values: <code>LOCAL_BASIC</code>: local disk, <code>LOCAL_SSD</code>: local SSD disk, <code>CLOUD_BASIC</code>: cloud disk, <code>CLOUD_SSD</code>: cloud SSD disk, <code>CLOUD_PREMIUM</code>: Premium Cloud Storage, <code>CLOUD_BSSD</code>: Basic SSD, <code>CLOUD_HSSD</code>: Enhanced SSD, <code>CLOUD_TSSD</code>: Tremendous SSD. NOTE: If modified, the instance may force stop.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="tags_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#tags_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">tags</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">map(string)</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>A mapping of tags to assign to the resource. For tag limits, please refer to <a href="https://intl.cloud.tencent.com/document/product/651/13354">Use Limits</a>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="user_data_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#user_data_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">user_<wbr>data</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The user data to be injected into this instance. Must be base64 encoded and up to 16 KB. If <code>userDataReplaceOnChange</code> is set to <code>true</code>, updates to this field will trigger the destruction and recreation of the CVM instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="user_data_raw_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#user_data_raw_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">user_<wbr>data_<wbr>raw</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The user data to be injected into this instance, in plain text. Conflicts with <code>userData</code>. Up to 16 KB after base64 encoded. If <code>userDataReplaceOnChange</code> is set to <code>true</code>, updates to this field will trigger the destruction and recreation of the CVM instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="user_data_replace_on_change_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#user_data_replace_on_change_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">user_<wbr>data_<wbr>replace_<wbr>on_<wbr>change</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">bool</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>When used in combination with <code>userData</code> or <code>userDataRaw</code> will trigger a destroy and recreate of the CVM instance when set to <code>true</code>. Default is <code>false</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="vpc_id_hcl">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#vpc_id_hcl" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">vpc_<wbr>id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The ID of a VPC network. If you want to create instances in a VPC network, this parameter must be set.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>
</div>

<div>
<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="java">
<dl class="resources-properties"><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="allocatepublicip_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#allocatepublicip_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">allocate<wbr>Public<wbr>Ip</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Associate a public IP address with an instance in a VPC or Classic. Boolean value, Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="antiddospackageid_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#antiddospackageid_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">anti<wbr>Ddos<wbr>Package<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="availabilityzone_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#availabilityzone_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">availability<wbr>Zone</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The available zone for the CVM instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="bandwidthpackageid_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#bandwidthpackageid_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">bandwidth<wbr>Package<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>bandwidth package id. if user is standard user, then the bandwidthPackageId is needed, or default has bandwidth_package_id.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="camrolename_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#camrolename_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cam<wbr>Role<wbr>Name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>CAM role name authorized to access.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="cdhhostid_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#cdhhostid_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cdh<wbr>Host<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Id of cdh instance. Note: it only works when instanceChargeType is set to <code>CDHPAID</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="cdhinstancetype_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#cdhinstancetype_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cdh<wbr>Instance<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Type of instance created on cdh, the value of this parameter is in the format of CDH_XCXG based on the number of CPU cores and memory capacity. Note: it only works when instanceChargeType is set to <code>CDHPAID</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="cputopology_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#cputopology_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">cpu<wbr>Topology</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#instancecputopology">Cpu<wbr>Topology</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>CPU topology configuration. Only supported when creating instances.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="datadisks_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#datadisks_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">data<wbr>Disks</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type"><a href="#instancedatadisk">List&lt;Data<wbr>Disk&gt;</a></span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Settings for data disks.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="dedicatedclusterid_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#dedicatedclusterid_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">dedicated<wbr>Cluster<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Exclusive cluster id.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="dedicatedresourcepackids_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#dedicatedresourcepackids_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">dedicated<wbr>Resource<wbr>Pack<wbr>Ids</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>List of dedicated resource pack IDs (e.g., rpp-xxxxxxxx). When creating instances using pre-purchased resource pool packs, this parameter must be specified together with <code>dedicatedResourcePackTenancy</code> to match the corresponding tenancy strategy. Related resource: <code>tencentcloudCvmResourcePoolPacks</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="dedicatedresourcepacktenancy_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#dedicatedresourcepacktenancy_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">dedicated<wbr>Resource<wbr>Pack<wbr>Tenancy</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Dedicated resource pack tenancy strategy. Valid values: <code>ResourcePool</code> (use instance resource pool for resource pre-deduction).</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="disableapitermination_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#disableapitermination_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable<wbr>Api<wbr>Termination</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether the termination protection is enabled. Default is <code>false</code>. If set true, which means that this instance can not be deleted by an API action.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="disableautomationservice_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#disableautomationservice_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable<wbr>Automation<wbr>Service</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Disable enhance service for automation, it is enabled by default. When this options is set, monitor agent won't be installed. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="disablemonitorservice_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#disablemonitorservice_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable<wbr>Monitor<wbr>Service</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Disable enhance service for monitor, it is enabled by default. When this options is set, monitor agent won't be installed. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="disablesecurityservice_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#disablesecurityservice_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disable<wbr>Security<wbr>Service</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Disable enhance service for security, it is enabled by default. When this options is set, security agent won't be installed. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="disasterrecovergroupids_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#disasterrecovergroupids_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">disaster<wbr>Recover<wbr>Group<wbr>Ids</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Placement group ID list. Supports up to 3 group IDs. When set, <code>placementGroupId</code> will be ignored and this list will be used for CRUD operations.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="enablejumboframe_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#enablejumboframe_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">enable<wbr>Jumbo<wbr>Frame</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to enable jumbo frames for the instance. Only supported instance types accept <code>true</code>. See https://cloud.tencent.com/document/product/213/11518 for supported instance types. <strong>NOTE: modifying this field automatically reboots the instance (<code>AutoReboot</code> is always set to <code>true</code> on update); use with caution</strong>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="forcedelete_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#forcedelete_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">force<wbr>Delete</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Indicate whether to force delete the instance. Default is <code>false</code>. If set true, the instance will be permanently deleted instead of being moved into the recycle bin. Note: only works for <code>PREPAID</code> instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="forcereplaceplacementgroupid_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#forcereplaceplacementgroupid_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">force<wbr>Replace<wbr>Placement<wbr>Group<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to force the instance host to be replaced. Value range: true: Allows the instance to change the host and restart the instance. Local disk machines do not support specifying this parameter; false: Does not allow the instance to change the host and only join the placement group on the current host. This may cause the placement group to fail to change. Can be used with both <code>placementGroupId</code> and <code>disasterRecoverGroupIds</code>. Default is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="forcestop_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#forcestop_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">force<wbr>Stop</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to forcibly shut down a running instance. Default is false. Forcing a shutdown is equivalent to switching off the power button on a physical computer. Forcing a shutdown may result in data loss or file system corruption; therefore, please use this option only when the server cannot be shut down normally.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="hostname_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#hostname_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">hostname</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The hostname of the instance. Windows instance: The name should be a combination of 2 to 15 characters comprised of letters (case insensitive), numbers, and hyphens (-). Period (.) is not supported, and the name cannot be a string of pure numbers. Other types (such as Linux) of instances: The name should be a combination of 2 to 60 characters, supporting multiple periods (.). The piece between two periods is composed of letters (case insensitive), numbers, and hyphens (-). Changing the <code>hostname</code> will cause the instance system to restart.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="hpcclusterid_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#hpcclusterid_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">hpc<wbr>Cluster<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>High-performance computing cluster ID. If the instance created is a high-performance computing instance, you need to specify the cluster in which the instance is placed, otherwise it cannot be specified.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="imageid_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#imageid_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">image<wbr>Id</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The image to use for the instance. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="instancechargetype_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#instancechargetype_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance<wbr>Charge<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The charge type of instance. Valid values are <code>PREPAID</code>, <code>POSTPAID_BY_HOUR</code>, <code>SPOTPAID</code>, <code>CDHPAID</code> and <code>CDCPAID</code>. The default is <code>POSTPAID_BY_HOUR</code>. Note: TencentCloud International only supports <code>POSTPAID_BY_HOUR</code> and <code>CDHPAID</code>. <code>PREPAID</code> instance may not allow to delete before expired. <code>SPOTPAID</code> instance must set <code>spotInstanceType</code> and <code>spotMaxPrice</code> at the same time. <code>CDHPAID</code> instance must set <code>cdhInstanceType</code> and <code>cdhHostId</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="instancechargetypeprepaidperiod_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#instancechargetypeprepaidperiod_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance<wbr>Charge<wbr>Type<wbr>Prepaid<wbr>Period</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Integer</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The tenancy (time unit is month) of the prepaid instance, NOTE: it only works when instanceChargeType is set to <code>PREPAID</code>. Valid values are <code>1</code>, <code>2</code>, <code>3</code>, <code>4</code>, <code>5</code>, <code>6</code>, <code>7</code>, <code>8</code>, <code>9</code>, <code>10</code>, <code>11</code>, <code>12</code>, <code>24</code>, <code>36</code>, <code>48</code>, <code>60</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="instancechargetypeprepaidrenewflag_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#instancechargetypeprepaidrenewflag_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance<wbr>Charge<wbr>Type<wbr>Prepaid<wbr>Renew<wbr>Flag</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Auto renewal flag. Valid values: <code>NOTIFY_AND_AUTO_RENEW</code>: notify upon expiration and renew automatically, <code>NOTIFY_AND_MANUAL_RENEW</code>: notify upon expiration but do not renew automatically, <code>DISABLE_NOTIFY_AND_MANUAL_RENEW</code>: neither notify upon expiration nor renew automatically. Default value: <code>NOTIFY_AND_MANUAL_RENEW</code>. If this parameter is specified as <code>NOTIFY_AND_AUTO_RENEW</code>, the instance will be automatically renewed on a monthly basis if the account balance is sufficient. NOTE: it only works when instanceChargeType is set to <code>PREPAID</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="instancename_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#instancename_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance<wbr>Name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The name of the instance. The max length of instanceName is 128, and default value is <code>Terraform-CVM-Instance</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="instancetype_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#instancetype_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">instance<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The type of the instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="internetchargetype_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#internetchargetype_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">internet<wbr>Charge<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Internet charge type of the instance, Valid values are <code>BANDWIDTH_PREPAID</code>, <code>TRAFFIC_POSTPAID_BY_HOUR</code>, <code>BANDWIDTH_POSTPAID_BY_HOUR</code> and <code>BANDWIDTH_PACKAGE</code>. If not set, internet charge type are consistent with the cvm charge type by default. This value takes NO Effect when changing and does not need to be set when <code>allocatePublicIp</code> is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="internetmaxbandwidthout_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#internetmaxbandwidthout_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">internet<wbr>Max<wbr>Bandwidth<wbr>Out</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Integer</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Maximum outgoing bandwidth to the public network, measured in Mbps (Mega bits per second). This value does not need to be set when <code>allocatePublicIp</code> is false.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="ipv4addresstype_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#ipv4addresstype_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ipv4Address<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>AddressType. Default value: WanIP. For beta users of dedicated IP. the value can be: HighQualityEIP: Dedicated IP. Note that dedicated IPs are only available in partial regions. For beta users of Anti-DDoS IP, the value can be: AntiDDoSEIP: Anti-DDoS EIP. Note that Anti-DDoS IPs are only available in partial regions.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="ipv6addresscount_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#ipv6addresscount_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ipv6Address<wbr>Count</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Integer</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Specify the number of randomly generated IPv6 addresses for the Elastic Network Interface.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="ipv6addresstype_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#ipv6addresstype_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">ipv6Address<wbr>Type</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>IPv6 AddressType. Default value: WanIP. EIPv6: Elastic IPv6; HighQualityEIPv6: Premium IPv6, only China Hong Kong supports premium IPv6. To allocate IPv6 addresses to resources, please specify the Elastic IPv6 type.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="keepimagelogin_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#keepimagelogin_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">keep<wbr>Image<wbr>Login</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Whether to keep image login or not, default is <code>false</code>. When the image type is private or shared or imported, this parameter can be set <code>true</code>. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system..</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="keyids_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#keyids_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">key<wbr>Ids</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;String&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The key pair to use for the instance, it looks like <code>skey-16jig7tx</code>. Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-deprecated"
            title="Optional, Deprecated">
        <span id="keyname_java">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#keyname_java" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">key<wbr>Name</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>

Modifications may lead to the reinstallation of the instance's operating system.<p class="property-message">Deprecated: Please use <code>keyIds</code> instead.</p></dd><dt class="property-optional property-replacement"

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Integer</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>The partition number of the placement group. Valid values: 1-30. If not specified when creating an instance with a partition placement group, the partition number will be randomly assigned. Required when modifying <code>disasterRecoverGroupIds</code> or <code>placementGroupId</code> in update operations.</dd><dt class="property-optional property-secret"

        <span class="property-type">String</span>

        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">Boolean</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Release elastic IP. Under EIP 2.0, only the first EIP under the primary network card is provided, and the EIP types are limited to HighQualityEIP, AntiDDoSEIP, EIPv6, and HighQualityEIPv6. Default behavior is not released.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

            title="Optional">

    </dt>
    <dd>Billing method of a pay-as-you-go instance after shutdown. Available values: <code>KEEP_CHARGING</code>,<code>STOP_CHARGING</code>. Default <code>KEEP_CHARGING</code>.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

    </dt>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="systemdiskencrypt_java">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>

        <span class="property-type">Integer</span>
    </dt>

            title="Optional">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">String</span>
    </dt>

NOTE: If modified, the instance may force stop.</dd><dt class="property-optional"

        <span class="property-type">String</span>

    <dd>The user data to be injected into this instance. Must be base64 encoded and up to 16 KB. If <code>userDataReplaceOnChange</code> is set to <code>true</code>, updates to this field will trigger the destruction and recreation of the CVM instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">

If <code>userDataReplaceOnChange</code> is set to <code>true</code>, updates to this field will trigger the destruction and recreation of the CVM instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
